programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul is heavily indebted and has to bring up his two notorious nephews and a niece. One day, the kids go to a carnival and befriend a runaway bride. Trouble ensues when they decide to help her by bringing her home and keep her out of Rahul's sight.

programme.title: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programme.desc: A group of Indian POW (Prisoners of War) from the 1971 Indo-Pak war rebels against the Pakistani army and tries to escape from their captivity. Helping the group in the mission is Gaurav, the son of a former Army Major also held captive by the enemy.

programme.title: Mera Damad
programme.desc: Dutiful son Jai (Farooq Sheikh) goes to meet his potential future wife selected by his father. Somehow, he steps into the wrong village and decides to stay in a mansion for one night before heading back. But then he meets and ends up falling in love with Kimi (Zarina Wahab), the daughter of the eccentric mansion-owner. How will Jai communicate his decision to his father and how will the families react to this breach of trust?

programme.title: Doli Saja Ke Rakhna
programme.desc: Two star-crossed lovers are prompted to elope when the girl's burly brothers refuse to let them live in peace. But the overwhelmed youngsters start second guessing their decision when they see life for what it is.​

programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: The story revolves around the lives of four guys named Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman who all absurdly fall for the same girl. Hence, begins the hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.
